J62.label: covered
J62.reason: The expect is not awaited, but Playwright 1.64 fails the test when an assertion is still pending at test end (verified: a wrong value fails with "Test ended." every time). A broken badge is never missed, so covered. The missing await does cost something: when the check has not settled by test end it fails a correct page too (about 1 CI run in 6), a flaky test rather than a weak one.
J62.borderline: The answer depends on how the test runner behaves, which a reader of the code cannot see; verified at runtime. First recorded as "the right value passes 20 of 20"; CI later showed false failures, so the reason was corrected and the label kept.
